correctness.rationale: The theorem follows from exact layer-cake decomposition into binary cuts, a per-pair Gini loss at least the pair gap, a geometric lower bound for binary carry differences, equality at monotone suffix binary blocks, and a proved integer ratio comparison for every n. Embedded exact checker exhausts binary cuts n=2..12 and tests balanced minimizers n=9..160, without passing off these finite computations as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete-pair absolute-difference contraction of a canonical one-pass ordered gossip sweep is a natural finite-stage stability invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The exact dimension law and attained suffix extremizers determine a sharp deficit asymptotic 8/n² and an optimizer transition at n=9, information unavailable from qualitative convergence or ordinary l2 spectral estimates. It informs comparison of consensus ordering choices without claiming a downstream theorem.
